claims.statement: Fronius states that warranty claims are handled between the installer and Fronius and that valid service cases can trigger replacement equipment.
Demand hypothesis: wholesalers will subsidize an evidence relay because installer-handled claims create a recurring channel-service burden and measurable recoveries.

contrary_evidence: OEMs already provide their own portals and troubleshooting tools.
The cited Fronius reimbursement terms are market-specific and may not transfer to Poland.

economics.acquisition_route: Private-label pilots with two wholesalers, using the founder's family installer as a design partner.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 300 installer accounts at 1200 PLN monthly can support over 4 million PLN ARR and a founder stake plausibly exceeding 5 million PLN in four to six years.
economics.founder_time: Three hours daily until channel onboarding becomes repeatable.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 80-90% software margin after document extraction and support.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: setup capital returns after 20 installers or roughly 120 accepted claims.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 500-1500 PLN monthly per installer plus 8-12% of recovered labour or credits.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Mixed fleets create recurring faults, replacements, and reimbursement reconciliation.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Each resolved claim improves the model-specific evidence rules, fault-code mappings, and reimbursement benchmarks.
fingerprint.customer: EU solar installers and small O&M firms with mixed inverter fleets.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Solar wholesalers embed it in installer portals and service desks as a private-label after-sales benefit.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Software assembles OEM-specific claim packs, tracks RMAs, and reconciles parts and labour credits on subscription plus success fee.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A wholesaler or installer pays a subscription and a fee when a claim is accepted or reimbursed.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An inverter fault triggers a claim whose serial, registration, diagnostics, labour, and shipment evidence sit in different systems.

founder_fit: The family renewable-energy company can supply workflows without cold-start public exposure.
The evidence graph fits data-science automation and part-time operation.
risks: OEM portal restrictions could prevent automated submission.
Success fees may conflict with distributor or warranty terms.

structure.critical_dependency: Export or API access to monitoring, distributor, and OEM claim records.

thesis: An embedded evidence relay can turn inverter faults into complete OEM warranty submissions and reconcile every reimbursement for small solar installers.
title: Solar Warranty Relay for Installer Networks
uncertainties: Installer claim volume and labour-credit value are unverified.
Wholesaler willingness to private-label the product is unverified.
